Did you know

For parents: voice answers use the browser's built-in speech recognition. In Chrome and Edge the audio is processed by the browser maker's speech service; the game itself records nothing, stores nothing, and has no accounts. Speech recognition needs an internet connection. Voice works in Chrome and Edge; if it is unavailable or blocked, the game offers typed answers instead. The browser asks for microphone permission when the game starts listening; an adult can approve it.
